data.one_liner: Code generator for the Isar Database to find and process classes annotated with @Collection.
data.what_it_does: It is the companion code generator for the Isar Database. It processes classes annotated with @Collection to generate the necessary database schema and querying code.
use_when: You are using the Isar Database in your Dart or Flutter project
You need to generate database mapping and query code for annotated models
avoid_when: You are not using the Isar Database
You prefer schema definitions without code generation
strengths: Automates boilerplate code generation for Isar models
Integrates seamlessly with the build system
weaknesses: Requires running a build step during development
Not documented locally, requires referring to the main Isar repository
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up build_runner to generate code alongside isar_community.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer traditional SQLite databases over NoSQL solutions like Isar.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a robust, type-safe SQLite database with rich reactive queries and migrations.
